ingredients.notes: All ingredients use edible gram weights. Allergen disclosures and the new illustration were checked against the ingredient list.

method.notes: Four servings of three cups. Twelve cups use an estimated 25 g of cucumber and 20 g filling each. The tuna is weighed drained, and the cucumber is weighed after hollowing. AFCD F009300 matches the drained water-packed tuna type; fat content varies by brand. AFCD F003320 is a raw unpeeled cucumber composition proxy for cups after the centres are removed. Preparation was reviewed against two independent cucumber cup recipes. The exact mass and number were not physically tested.

food_safety.notes: Drain commercially canned tuna, wash produce, keep the filling refrigerated, assemble just before serving and promptly refrigerate leftovers.

servings_and_time.notes: 4 portions with 20 minutes including the specified cooking and resting or cooling periods.
